title: Digital health for Tuberculosis control: findings from the piloting of an electronic medical record in Luanda (Angola)
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
why_not: Abstract only, and the system is a tuberculosis-only patient record piloted in three Luanda facilities (January 2022 to February 2023): class tracker, noted not assessed; it states no fact on a general-care EMR aspect.
